description: A test suite for IRC protocol functions including parsing lines, prefixes, sanitizing outbound text, validating targets, and splitting text into chunks.

methods.name: parseIrcLine
methods.description: Parses a raw IRC line into its components including prefix, command, params, and trailing message.

methods.name: parseIrcPrefix
methods.description: Parses the prefix part of an IRC message into nickname, user, and host.

methods.name: sanitizeIrcOutboundText
methods.description: Sanitizes text for outbound IRC messages to prevent control characters and command injections.

methods.name: sanitizeIrcTarget
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes an IRC target, rejecting invalid characters or control sequences.

methods.name: splitIrcText
methods.description: Splits a long IRC message into chunks based on a specified maximum length.
